title: HTML catalogue
description: The Gramlot Base theme applied to native HTML.
explanation: Explore typography, lists, tables and native controls. The catalogue documents which grammar entries can be demonstrated here and which require another context.

title: Hello World
description: A heading and a paragraph: the smallest Gramlot page.
explanation: The Page class defines main(root). Each builder call adds a typed Source node; the integration hosts the page and Gramlot renders it.

title: Text and links
description: Headings, inline text, quotations, code and links.
explanation: Follow the nested builder calls to see how text and child elements coexist. The example includes an internal anchor and literal text that is escaped rather than interpreted as markup.

title: Lists
description: Ordered, unordered and nested lists, plus a glossary.
explanation: Local sequences supply the content. Loops create the repeated list items, while nesting expresses the document hierarchy.

title: Semantic page
description: A page composed from meaningful HTML landmarks.
explanation: Header, navigation, article, aside and footer give the content structure. Ordinary page methods divide construction into readable sections.

title: Tables
description: A catalogue with headings, rows and totals.
explanation: A row helper and a loop build the table from fixed data. Caption and scoped headings describe its structure; the footer presents the calculated total.

title: Forms
description: Native fields, choices, buttons and a slider.
explanation: Try typing, selecting options and moving the slider. Reset restores defaults. The submit button is disabled: this example has no save endpoint or application event handlers.

title: Native disclosure
description: Expandable questions and native progress indicators.
explanation: The browser supplies details/summary interaction. Progress and meter values are static; the example introduces no bindings or controllers.

title: SVG shapes
description: The basic SVG vocabulary inside an HTML page.
explanation: The SVG builder creates shapes within a viewBox. Coordinates determine geometry, while the shared theme supplies colors through semantic CSS variables.

title: SVG composition
description: A scene assembled with groups, paths and repeated objects.
explanation: Helper methods build houses, trees and flowers. Loops place repeated elements, and group transformations position their local coordinates.

title: Cards with icons
description: HTML cards with SVG icons and feature lists.
explanation: A helper composes each card, while loops populate cards and their features. The common theme owns the appearance; local CSS handles only the example layout.

title: Static report
description: A summary, chart, legend and table from the same data.
explanation: Separate methods build each section. SVG bar lengths and table cells use one local dataset, making the connection between values and geometry explicit.

title: Complete page
description: An event page with a programme, speakers, map and FAQ.
explanation: The main method assembles named sections. Helpers and nested loops compose the schedule, speaker cards and SVG map from fixed local data.
